svg.title: Trickbound · Town and station v2 (#21) · Direction C: Side-on stage
svg.text: Trickbound · Town and station v2 (#21) · Direction C: Side-on stage
Cinder Hollow, Leg 1. Concept sheet, code-drawn SVG (no image model). Hex codes only from art/art-direction.md (draft).
The town at phone size (1x, 384 × 480 view)
Dashed box: what a portrait phone shows.
The station interior at phone size (1x, 384 × 320 view)
2x detail: a card table under the lamp
States: Arrival (one lamp of two working) → Lamp-lit (the town’s first critter wakes)
In the game: phone frame (390 wide) with the UI and the hand on top
Tap a label or a person
Idea: side-on painted panoramas you walk left and right, like a stage set: the mine headframe, the depot front, the train, the hall’s tall windows.
Risk: most cinematic, but it drops free roaming on the grid, each town needs a wide painting, and portrait phones show only a slice.
